en: Kill **The Bloated Miller**
Talk to **Renly** -> first **Uncut Skill Gem**
Kill **Beira of the Rotten Pack** -> **+10% cold resistance**
Grab the **Waypoint** at the **Tree of Souls**, then into **The Red Vale**
Activate 3 **Obelisks of Rust**, kill the **Rust King**
**Renly**: hand in the runes, take the **Runed Spikes**
Break the **3 Runic Seals** at the Tree of Souls with the Runed Spikes
Summon **Una** at the roots, then on to the **Cemetery of the Eternals**
Kill **Asinia** and **Draven** -> 2 Memorial Key Pieces
Kill **Lachlann of Endless Lament** at the **Memorial Gate** by the Waypoint
Kill **The Crowbell** -> **+2 passive points**
Cleanse 3 Ritual Altars, kill **The King in the Mists** -> **+30 Spirit**
**Finn**: pick a Charm, **Una**: buy a Greater Life/Mana Flask
Pick up **Una's Lute** -> **+2 passive points** from Una
Kill **The Executioner**, pull the lever, talk to **Leitis**
**Una**: hand in the lute -> **+2 passive points**
To **Ogham Manor**, reaching **level 13** on the way
Kill **Count Geonor** at **level 14**
Talk to the **Hooded One** -> **Follow the Beast's trail**
Kill **Rathbreaker**
Talk to the **Hooded One**, then **Asala** -> Desert Map **Mawdun Quarry**
Find the entrance to **Mawdun Mine**
Kill **Rudja, the Dread Engineer**, free **Risu**
Talk to **Risu**, then **Asala** -> Desert Map **Traitor's Passage**
Run through to **The Halani Gates**
Kill **Jamanra, the Risen King**
Take the Uncut Skill Gem (level 7) from **Zarka**, talk to **Asala** -> Desert Map **Mastodon Badlands**
**Trial of the Sekhemas** with Balbala's Barya (level 22)
Find the entrance to **The Bone Pits**
Kill **Iktab, the Deathlord & Ekbab, Ancient Steed** -> **Mastodon Tusks**
Kill **Kabala, Constrictor Queen** -> **+2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)**
Find the entrance to the **Buried Shrines**
Kill **Azarian, the Forsaken Son** -> **Essence of Water**
Activate the **3 Ancient Seals**: one at the end of each canyon
Kill **Zalmarath, the Colossus** -> **Flame Ruby**
Desert Map to the sandstorm (**Traitor's Passage**), then **Sound the Horn** at the front of the caravan
Take the **Final Letter** from **Fallen Dekhara** (for Shambrin: +2 passive points (+2 weapon set points))
Run through to **The Spires of Deshar**
Kill **Tor Gul, the Defiler**
Pick **The Dreadnought** on the Desert Map, hand the **Final Letter** to **Shambrin** while travelling -> **+2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)**
**Trial of the Sekhemas** with the level-28 Barya from Deshar
Kill **Jamanra, the Abomination** (act boss)
Talk to the **Hooded One** in the shrine northwest of the caravan's midpoint (down a ramp)
Run through to the **Ziggurat Encampment**
Talk to **Oswald**, check vendors
Kill **Mighty Silverfist** -> **+2 passive points** (+2 weapon set points)
Take the **Corpse-snake Venom** from the corpse
Run through to the **Chimeral Wetlands**
Kill **Xyclucian**, continue into **Jiquani's Machinarium**
Kill **Blackjaw** -> **Flame Core**: **+10% fire resistance**
Kill **Zicoatl** -> **Large Soul Core**
**Large Soul Core** into the **Stone Altar** -> opens the **Matlan Waterways**
Walk over the pressure pads, activate the **mechanism** at the end
Kill **Ignagduk** -> **Gemrot Skull: +30 Spirit** + Uncut Spirit Gem level 10
Talk to **Alva** at the bottom of the Ziggurat -> **Drowned City**
**Trial of Chaos** with the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum: ascendancy
Run through to the **Apex of Filth**
Kill the **Queen of Filth** -> **Temple Door Idol**
Kill **Mektul** -> Hammer of Kamasa to **Oswald**: **Reforging Bench**
Run all the way up, kill **Ketzuli**
Through the **Gateway**, down the stairs to **Utzaal**
Kill **Viper Napuatzi**
Sacrifice the **Sacrificial Heart** at the blood sacrifice altar -> **+2 passive points** (+2 weapon set points)
Kill **Doryani**
Talk to **Doryani**, then travel with **Alva** to **Kingsmarch**
Talk to **Doryani** and **Alva**, then **Makoru** at the ship -> Isle of Kin
Go through to the **Volcanic Warrens**
Kill **Krutog** -> weapon piece 1/3
Go through to **Journey's End**
Kill **Omniphobia** -> **+2 passive points** (+2 weapon set points)
Go through to **Solitary Confinement**
Kill **The Prisoner** -> weapon piece 2/3
Kill **Scourge of the Skies** -> weapon piece 3/3
Kill the **Great White One** -> **Shark Fin**
Kill **Diamora** -> free **Matiki**
**Silent Hall** -> **+5% max. mana**
Complete 3 tests -> **3 tattoos**
Talk to **Navali** -> **+2 passive points** (+2 weapon set points)
Talk to the **Hooded One**, then **Makoru** -> Arastas
Kill **Torvian**
Kill **Benedictus**
Talk to the **Hooded One**, then **Rhodri** at the ship -> Ngakanu
Kill **Tavakai**
Talk to the **Hooded One** -> Interludes unlocked
Talk to **Asala** and **Zarka**, take the north-east exit
Take **Molten One's Gift** -> **+5% max. life**
Just grab the **waypoint**, go back to the Khari Crossing
Kill **Akthi & Anundr** -> Risu: **+2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)**
Activate the **waypoint**, WP back to the Khari Bazaar
Through the **Ashen Forest** to **Kriar Village**
Kill **Lythara** -> **+40 Spirit**
Kill the **Abominable Yeti** -> Hilda: **+2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)**
Kill **Rakkar** -> Kriar Peaks
Talk to **Elder Madox** -> **1 Unique of your choice**
Kill **Stormgore** -> Cuachic Vault
Kill **Zolin & Zelina**, then **summon and talk to Doryani**
Kill **Elzarah**, then talk to **Asala**
Kill **Vornas** -> Qimah
Pick a **boon** at the Seven Pillars, summon **Jado**
Kill **Azmadi**, use the **Grand Barya**, talk to **Jado**
Kill **Isolde & Heldra** -> Stones of Serle
Activate the **6 megaliths**, then kill **Siora**
Checkpoint to the darkness, through **The Blackwood** to **Holten**
Buy Greater Runes from the **Soul of the Ferryman**
Kill **Oswin** -> **Warden's Ledger**: +2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)
Kill **Thane Wulfric & Lady Elswyth**
Talk to **Renly**, WP to Kingsmarch
**Hooded One**: get the Book of Specialisation -> **+2 passive points (+2 weapon set points)**
Talk to the **Hooded One** and **Doryani**, use the **Map Device**
Take the waystone from **Doryani**, reforge it up at the **Reforging Bench**
Head for **Powerful Map Bosses**: the boss drops a waystone one tier higher
First goal: the **Fortress quest line** for Atlas points
Stay at most **6-8 levels** below the map level
**Cap fire and lightning resistance**, leave cold open if you must

zone: Trial of the Sekhemas / Trial of Chaos
en: **Catch up on ascendancy**: 2nd trial with the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum (Act 3), 3rd with a level 60 Barya
